components.name: Cloud load balancer
components.description: Forwards external traffic to cluster ingress entry

components.name: Ingress controller
components.description: Watches Ingress and configures proxy routing

components.name: CoreDNS
components.description: Resolves service and Pod DNS names

operational_steps: Load balancer forwards to ingress controller
Ingress rule selects host / path backend
failure_checkpoint: DNS lookup, Ingress route or CNI connectivity failure
recovery_path: Check CoreDNS, Ingress controller logs, Service endpoints, CNI health and network policy.
